info.title: PASSO
info.description:
Italian e-invoicing relay: CRM to Sistema di Interscambio via a pluggable channel.

**Three rules that catch most integrations:**

1. **NS is terminal.** The invoice is legally *not issued*. Fix it and submit a NEW
   invoice — `/retry` refuses with 409. Auto-retrying sends a duplicate to the tax authority.
2. **MC is not a failure.** The invoice IS issued; SdI is still delivering. Do not resubmit.
3. **Money is a string.** `"1000.00"`, never `1000`. FatturaPA amounts are patterned
   strings with exactly two decimals; a bare integer is schema-invalid.

**Dual mode.** `mode: "async"` (default) returns 202 and reports progress by webhook.
`mode: "sync"` holds the connection until the invoice reaches SdI — it waits for the
**AT milestone only**, never RC, MC or DT, because MC delivery retry legally runs for
days and no HTTP timeout can represent it. On timeout you get a 202 and the job
continues untouched.

PASSO keeps **no invoice archive**. Payloads are purged once a terminal receipt
arrives; fetch what you need before then. Purged submissions return `410 Gone`.

post.description: Both signatures are sent during the overlap window, so a receiver can redeploy without downtime. Parse EVERY `v1=` in the header, not just the last.

200.description: The new secret and the overlap window

get.description: Everything PASSO holds for one submission — XML, rendering, receipts and hashes — in one call. Hashes are computed over the PLAINTEXT XML bytes so you can verify them independently. Take this BEFORE the terminal receipt arrives: afterwards the payload is purged and this returns 410.

410.description: Purged — PASSO holds no archive and there is no recovery path

post.description: Reports what PASSO actually holds for a subject. Almost always: nothing beyond configuration, because the CRM holds the archive. An in-flight document is refused for the LIVE TRANSMISSION, never for a retention duty PASSO does not have.

200.description: What is held, and whether it is erasable

post.description: Where Invoicetronic and OpenAPI.it push receipts. Authenticated by the per-tenant token in the path — vendor consoles frequently cannot send custom headers. Returns 200 even for a duplicate or a quarantine, so the vendor stops retrying something already handled.

400.description: Unparseable — the payload is never echoed back

413.description: Body exceeds the inbound limit, refused before parsing

200.description: Each event with terminal / legallyIssued / action
Unacknowledged receipts — these are never purged
The process is up. Checks nothing external.

get.description: Postgres, RabbitMQ and Redis. Deliberately EXCLUDES SdI vendors: a vendor outage must not take PASSO out of rotation.
